headline_marked: 2 accused [[confess to gang-raping woman]] in Moulvibazar
headline: 2 accused confess to gang-raping woman in Moulvibazar
summary: Two men have been arrested and given confessional statements before a magistrate after breaking into a home and raping a woman while her infant daughter was present.
details: Two men accused of gang-raping a woman in Moulvibazar town have been arrested and given confessional statements before a magistrate, police said.
The arrestees, identified as Ferdous Hossain (31) and Kannal Mia alias Joynal (39), were arrested during separate operations by the Moulvibazar Sadar Model Police Station.
According to the officer-in-charge, three masked men broke into the victim's home in the early hours of June 3, raping her under threat while she was sleeping with her infant daughter.
Police used digital intelligence to trace the suspects after the victim filed a case against unidentified persons.
Ferdous was apprehended in Savar, Dhaka, while Joynal was arrested in Moulvibazar town. Two mobile phones stolen during the crime were also recovered.
Both accused confessed to their involvement under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. A third suspect remains at large, and police are continuing operations to arrest him.
caption:
Two men have confessed to gang-raping a woman in her own home while her infant daughter was present.

Two men accused of gang-raping a woman in Moulvibazar town have been arrested and given confessional statements before a magistrate, police said.

The arrestees, identified as Ferdous Hossain (31) and Kannal Mia alias Joynal (39), were arrested during separate operations by the Moulvibazar Sadar Model Police Station.

According to the officer-in-charge, three masked men broke into the victim's home in the early hours of June 3, raping her under threat while she was sleeping with her infant daughter.

Police used digital intelligence to trace the suspects after the victim filed a case against unidentified persons.

Ferdous was apprehended in Savar, Dhaka, while Joynal was arrested in Moulvibazar town. Two mobile phones stolen during the crime were also recovered.

Both accused confessed to their involvement under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. A third suspect remains at large, and police are continuing operations to arrest him.
